project: NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026: Dancing with the SARs
audit_phase: Phase 3A.1: Classification Quality Audit and Correction

audit_findings.single_pol_quality_mask_defect: Original Phase 3A generate_candidate_mask checked ~np.isfinite(channel_db) in is_nodata_invalid. Because clipping-floor observations were assigned np.nan during feature extraction, is_nodata_invalid evaluated to True, causing single-polarization VV-only and VH-only masks to report 0 indeterminate pixels. Corrected by isolating quality mask categories directly from source bands before checking finiteness.
audit_findings.two_dimensional_otsu_off_diagonal_handli: Original Phase 3A 2D Otsu mapped off-diagonal quadrants Q2 (Low VV, High VH) and Q3 (High VV, Low VH) into Category 0 (Non-Water). This masked discordant observations such as flooded vegetation or wind-roughened water. Corrected by introducing explicit Category 4 (Ambiguous / Discordant Off-Diagonal), strictly conserving Q0 + Q1 + Q2 + Q3 = Total Valid Category 0 Cells.
audit_findings.kittler_illingworth_investigation: July 16 VV KI producing the identical threshold as Otsu across all 3 filters is confirmed as a GENUINE mathematical convergence: under near-equal-variance Gaussian bimodality (sigma0^2 ~= sigma1^2), minimizing KI within-class variance is mathematically equivalent to maximizing Otsu between-class variance. Conversely, July 16 unfiltered CR and Lee 3x3 CR KI solutions with class occupancy ~1.4% (2-4 bins from occupancy boundary) are identified as UNSTABLE BOUNDARY ARTIFACTS and rejected.
audit_findings.area_reconciliation: Reconciled all candidate water areas with exact 400 m2 pixel metrics. The net expansion of +64.52 km2 (Dual-AND Lee 5x5) is strictly identified as NET CANDIDATE WATER AREA CHANGE rather than pixel-wise newly inundated area.
